name: natyalok
description: Natyalok - A BookMyShow-like ticket booking system

scripts.test:e2e: cross-env NODE_ENV=test concurrently "node server.js" "wait-on https://localhost:3000 && jest tests/e2e --runInBand"
scripts.test:integration: cross-env NODE_ENV=test MONGO_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/natyalok_test concurrently "node server.js" "wait-on https://localhost:3000 && NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 jest tests/integration --runInBand"
scripts.test:all: concurrently "npm run test:unit" "npm run test:integration" "npm run test:e2e"
